description: Checks a project file and lists every problem with where it is: entries the editor would leave out, unknown parts, pins off the board, two parts' pins or leads in one hole, overlapping parts, wires that connect nothing (a loose end, or no pins on their net), duplicate wires, a two-lead part with both leads on one net (shorted out), a wire passing over a pin or lead without ending there (so not joined to it), IC pins and two-lead parts' leads connected to nothing, supply rails shorted together (a positive supply and ground, two different voltages, a battery's two terminals; VCC with 5V or GND with AGND is one rail), polarized parts in backwards (an LED, an electrolytic capacitor or + and − pins the wrong way round on the supply rails, or a diode conducting straight across the supply), and on a stripboard, pins shorted by a strip or sitting in a cut hole. The rails are pins named like VCC, GND or 5V, battery holders' terminals, and holes noted with a rail's name ("+9V"). With expectNets, every connection missing from the board or extra on it is an error. Enabled saved requirements also check intended connections, missing components/pins and unused pins; unspecified pins produce an incomplete-coverage warning, not a full match. Wires crossing each other are fine (insulated jumpers) and only listed in notes. Fix all errors before making a link. A project sent whole is kept here: the reply's projectId stands for it in every other tool.

expectNets.description: The nets the board should make: each a list of pins written REF.pin, e.g. [["U1.8", "U1.4", "R1.1", "J1.1"], ["U1.2", "U1.6", "C1.+"]]. A pin can also be named by its label ("U1.VCC", "D1.K") or as get_nets writes it ("U1.8 VCC"). List every net of two or more pins: a pin in none of them should connect to nothing. With a projectId it's remembered for that project, so later checks use it too; [] forgets it.

project.description: The whole project file (through version 8), or its JSON text (see perfboard://docs/project-file). Give this or projectId. Preserve instanceId and optional requirements fields.

projectId.description: The id of a project kept here (from new_project, validate_project, edit_project or read_share_link), instead of sending the whole project.

name: validate_project
title: Validate project
